title: authority/flight/v1
description: One frame of the optional national push WS /v1/authority/flights (spec 02 F7, docs/PLAN.md D12): the common envelope with one airborne flight as body, in the ASTM F3411-22a RIDFlight shape (uas_standards f3411 v22a, the file pinned in api/standards/), once a second per flight. The body is checked by uspace-core's f3411.UnmarshalRIDFlight before it is sent; this schema names the members a consumer dispatches on. Special values (speed 255, track 361, vertical speed 63, altitudes and height -1000) mean unknown. No operator location: that is flight details, served to authorised Display Providers on GET /uss/flights/{id}/details only. backlog is true for a frame buffered while no client was connected.
